selection.diff_summary:
Summary: This change updates VPlanTransforms to use more explicit and centralized handling for vectorization plan simplification and induction/live-out optimization. It adds a helper to compute induction end values up front, rewires induction exit/live-out replacement to consume those precomputed values, replaces several ad hoc constant constructions with plan-provided zero/all-ones values, and tightens recipe simplification rules so new VP recipes are only created when safe. It also refactors memory alias checks in VPlan hoisting/sinking to use direct alias queries and introduces grouped processing of replicated memory ops by SCEV address and dominance order. Tests were updated for predicated loop/vectorization cases.
Mechanisms: VPlan induction live-out and exit-user rewriting now precomputes end values for wide inductions before replacing exiting IV users; Adds a helper to derive/truncate induction end values for canonical and non-canonical wide inductions using vector trip count or folded tail trip count; Simplifies masked/boolean recipe folding with stronger guards against creating new VPInstructions/recipes in unsafe cases; Changes memory alias decision logic from scoped no-alias checks to direct alias-result queries; Groups replicated load/store recipes by address SCEV and sorts each group by VPDominatorTree dominance before further handling; Uses plan-level zero/all-ones constants instead of constructing new IR constants in several simplifications; Updates canonical IV removal and induction optimization conditions for scalar-VF-only and truncated induction cases
